fields.title: Kōgyō Bumon Rōdōsha Sikyū oyobi Kyōkyū Hōkoku
fields.subject: Kōgyō rōdōsha ni taisuru kyōkyū busshi no genjō oyobi wariate fusoku no gen'in chōsa

operations.production: Wariate fusoku ni yori rōdō nōritsu 25% teika

findings: Genjō no wariate hōsei wa rōdō jin’in no zōka ni tsuitsui shite orazu, kyōkyū busshi ga kyūkyoku ni fusoku shite iru.
Tanaka Hiroshi no seikyū suru wariate zōryō wa kōgyō seisan o iji suru tame ni fukaketsu de aru.

financial.notes: Rōdōsha no seikatsu kijun iji no tame no yosan tsuika.

recommendations: Kōgyōyō kyōkyū wariate o zōryō shi, rōdōsha no seikatsu hoshō o okonau koto.

claims.fact: Kaisha hōkoku wa wariate fusoku ga rōdō nōritsu ni akueikyō o ataete iru koto o shōmei shite iru.
